name: status-probe
description: Status bar items driven by your own commands: each prints JSON lines (text, tooltip, ok/warn/error, a link), re-run on an interval or run as an event listener.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Status Probe runs commands from your settings, so it only runs in trusted workspaces.

statusProbe.items.markdownDescription: Status bar items. Each item re-runs `command` every `intervalSeconds`, or with `watch` runs it as an event listener that prints a line per event. A line may be JSON `{ "text", "tooltip", "level", "open" }`; anything else shows as plain text.

command.markdownDescription: Shell command to run. Supports `${workspaceFolder}` and `${userHome}`.

watch.markdownDescription: Run the command as an event listener instead of re-running it every `intervalSeconds`: started once, it prints a line per event, and each line becomes the item's status. If it exits, it is started again with backoff.

intervalSeconds.markdownDescription: Seconds between runs, minimum 10. `0` turns the timer off: the item runs at startup, when clicked, and when a task from `refreshOnTasks` ends. Not used with `watch`.

timeoutSeconds.description: Stop the command and show an error after this many seconds (ignored with watch).

refreshOnTasks.markdownDescription: VS Code task labels that refresh this item when they end, however they were started (a task button, **Tasks: Run Task**, a keybinding). A trailing `*` matches a prefix: `"Deploy staging*"`.

showTaskProgress.markdownDescription: Show a spinner on the item while a task from `refreshOnTasks` is running.

priority.description: Higher sits farther toward the outer edge of its side.
